title.narrative: Three Day Workshop on Cultural (and National Heritage) Policy Development

description.narrative: The idea of the preservation of natural and cultural heritage has entered into the international arena with the adoption of the ‘Convention Concerning the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage in 1972. This convention was introduced considering the global context that disturbs or harms the cultural and natural heritages in the world. Therefore, this proposed project will cover the subject area that was emphasized by the 1972 convention. Even Though government has paid more attention to the culture and heritage sector, absence of a national policy for culture and heritage to ensure the long-lasting safeguard of the sector is a critical issue. Hence, the main objective of the proposed project is to to develop a national policy for the Cultural and National Heritage sector in Sri Lanka through a residential workshop. Since the culture and heritage are a very sensitive and dynamic area, policy preparation to satisfy all stakeholders is a challenge. Therefore, this workshop will be designed as a three-day residential workshop and includes consultation sessions with the participation of relevant stakeholders in the public sector, private sector and NGO sector. It is expected to have around 40 participants for the workshop. Facilitation of the reputed resource person who has both national and international experience on making cultural and heritage policy will be taken to conduct the workshop. Especially his experiences and active participation in UNESCO, will be an additional valuve for success for the task. During the workshop, the first draft of the national policy document will be done and shared among all stakeholders to obtain their comments and opinion. As the final output of the project there will be a policy document for the culture and heritage sector in Sri Lanka.
